license_required.quote: To practice optometry in this Commonwealth without holding a license issued by the Board.

type.quote: The Board shall be composed of six members as follows: five licensed optometrists and one citizen member.

degree_required.quote: the applicant has been graduated and received a doctor of optometry degree from a school of optometry approved by the Board.

accrediting_body.quote: a school of optometry approved by the Board.

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
exams.notes: Board may determine a satisfactory score on any written examination of the NBEO.
exams.quote: The Board may determine a score that it considers satisfactory on any written examination of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry.

exams.notes: Required for TPA certification; passage of such examinations as determined by the Board.
exams.quote: Passage of such examinations as are determined to be reasonable and necessary by the Board to ensure an appropriate standard of medical care for patients.

interval_years.quote: each optometrist shall be required to complete 20 hours of continuing education relating to optometry, as approved by the Board, each year.

value: At least 10 hours through real-time, interactive activities (in-person or electronic)
No more than 2 hours in recordkeeping/coding/practice management
For TPA-certified optometrists: at least 10 hours in ocular and general pharmacology, diagnosis and treatment of the human eye and its adnexa
topical_requirements.quote: At least 10 hours shall be obtained through real-time, interactive activities...No more than two hours may consist of courses related to recordkeeping...For TPA-certified optometrists, at least 10 hours shall be in the areas of ocular and general pharmacology, diagnosis and treatment of the human eye and its adnexa

regulatory_model.quote: To practice optometry in this Commonwealth without holding a license issued by the Board.

credential_type.quote: Every candidate successfully passing the examination shall be licensed by the Board if such candidate possesses the qualifications required by law and regulation to practice optometry.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person: 1. To practice optometry in this Commonwealth without holding a license issued by the Board.

title_protection.quote: Any person who in any way advertises himself as an optometrist or uses the title of doctor of optometry (O.D.) or any other letters or title in connection with his name which in any way conveys the impression that he is engaged in the practice of optometry shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing or offering to practice optometry, or the public representation of being qualified to practice the same by any person not authorized to practice optometry, shall be sufficient evidence of a violation of the law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in his practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any felony under the laws of the Commonwealth, another state, the District of Columbia, or any United States possession or territory or of any misdemeanor under such laws involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner that endangers the health and welfare of patients or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in such a manner as to endanger the health and welfare of his patients or the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs rendering the optometrist unsafe to practice, or mental/physical illness rendering them unsafe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of alcohol or drugs to the extent such use renders him unsafe to practice optometry or mental or physical illness rendering him unsafe to practice optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully employing an unlicensed person to perform acts requiring an optometry license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and willfully employing an unlicensed person to do anything for which a license to practice optometry is required;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Neglecting or refusing to display the current year license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Neglecting or refusing to display his license for the current year;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee by fraud or misrepresentation, or practicing deception or fraud upon any patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining of any fee by fraud or misrepresentation or the practice of deception or fraud upon any patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that deceives, misleads, or defrauds the public, claims professional superiority, or offers free services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that directly or indirectly deceives, misleads, or defrauds the public, claims professional superiority, or offers free optometrical services or examinations;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring, or inducing an unlicensed person to practice optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, or inducing a person not licensed to practice optometry to so practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not duly licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not duly licensed to practice in the Commonwealth;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice optometry under a name other than one's own licensed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice optometry under a name other than one's own name as set forth on the license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lending, leasing, renting, or otherwise placing one's license at the disposal of an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lending, leasing, renting, or in any other manner placing his license at the disposal or in the service of any person not licensed to practice optometry in the Commonwealth;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Splitting or dividing a fee with any person other than a licensed optometrist who is a legal partner or co-member of a professional LLC
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Splitting or dividing a fee with any person or persons other than with a licensed optometrist who is a legal partner or comember of a professional limited liability company formed to engage in the practice of optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry where a commercial establishment officer/employee controls the professional judgment of the optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing optometry where any officer, employee, or agent of a commercial or mercantile establishment...directly or indirectly controls, dictates, or influences the professional judgment...of the licensed optometrist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating other standards of conduct as adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating other standards of conduct as adopted by the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating, assisting, inducing, or cooperating with others in violating any provisions of law relating to the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, assisting, inducing, or cooperating with others in violating any provisions of law relating to the practice of optometry, including the provisions of this chapter or of any regulation of the Board.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry includes: examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions; employment of subjective or objective mechanisms to determine accommodative or refractive states; use of testing appliances; examination, diagnosis, and optometric treatment of conditions and visual or muscular anomalies; evaluation, examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal or diseased conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; preoperative and postoperative care; and use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry includes: 1. Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics

value: examination and diagnosis
prescribing lenses, prisms, ocular exercises, visual training, orthoptics
use of testing appliances
optometric treatment of visual and muscular anomalies
treatment of abnormal or diseased conditions using medically recognized devices, procedures, or technologies
preoperative and postoperative care
use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents
therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (TPA-certified)
laser surgery (peripheral iridotomy, selective laser trabeculoplasty, YAG capsulotomy) for certified optometrists
intramuscular epinephrine for anaphylactic shock
methods_authorized.quote: Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics and the prescribing or adapting of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics for the correction, relief, remediation, or prevention of such conditions... Use of testing appliances for the purpose of the measurement of the powers of vision... Examination, diagnosis, and optometric treatment in accordance with this chapter of conditions and visual or muscular anomalies of the human eye... Evaluation, examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal or diseased conditions of the human eye and its adnexa by the use of medically recognized and appropriate devices, procedures, or technologies... Preoperative and postoperative care related to the human eye and adnexa... Use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents set forth in § 54.1-3221... An optometrist may (i) treat certain diseases or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa with certain therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as permitted under this chapter and (ii) administer intramuscular epinephrine for the treatment of emergency cases of anaphylactic shock.

drug_authority.value: TPA-certified optometrists may prescribe and administer Schedule II (hydrocodone/acetaminophen combination), III, IV, V, and VI controlled substances for treatment of diseases and abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (Schedule VI) may be administered topically by all licensed optometrists.
drug_authority.quote: TPA certification shall enable an optometrist to prescribe and administer, within his scope of practice, Schedule II controlled substances consisting of hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen and Schedules III through VI controlled substances and devices

surgery_prohibited.quote: Except as provided in §§ 54.1-3222 and 54.1-3225, the practice of optometry does not include treatment through: 1. Surgery

surgery_definition.value: Surgery includes retina laser procedures; laser procedures into the vitreous chamber; LASIK and PRK; penetrating keratoplasty and corneal transplants; surgery related to removal of the eye; full-thickness incision or excision of the cornea or sclera; incision of the iris and ciliary body; incision of the vitreous humor or retina; full-thickness conjunctivoplasty; eyelid surgery; bony orbit surgery; surgical extraction of the crystalline lens; intraocular implants; and incisional/excisional surgery of extraocular muscles, lacrimal system, and pterygium.
surgery_definition.quote: Surgery, including: a. Retina laser procedures; laser procedures into the vitreous chamber of the eye to treat vitreous, retinal, or macular disease; laser in situ keratomileusis and photorefractive keratectomy eye surgery; or other laser surgery;

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: The foregoing shall not restrict the authority of any optometrist licensed or certified under this chapter for the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye and its adnexa

value: peripheral iridotomy
selective laser trabeculoplasty
YAG capsulotomy
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: The Board shall certify an optometrist to perform laser surgery consisting of peripheral iridotomy, selective laser trabeculoplasty, and YAG capsulotomy

value: injection of steroid for treatment of chalazia
probing or related procedures of the lacrimal system
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Administration of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents by injection shall be limited to the treatment of chalazia by means of injection of a steroid included in Schedule VI controlled substances

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Treatment of angle closure glaucoma shall be limited to initiation of immediate emergency care.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: administer intramuscular epinephrine for the treatment of emergency cases of anaphylactic shock.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics and the prescribing or adapting of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics

value: Schedule II limited to hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen only
Treatment of infantile or congenital glaucoma is prohibited
Injections limited to steroid for chalazia treatment (Schedule VI)
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: TPA certification shall enable an optometrist to prescribe and administer, within his scope of practice, Schedule II controlled substances consisting of hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen and Schedules III through VI controlled substances

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Treatment with oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents shall be limited to (i) analgesics included on Schedule II controlled substances...consisting of hydrocodone in combination with acetaminophen, and analgesics included on Schedules III through VI...and (ii) other Schedule VI controlled substances...appropriate to treat diseases and abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa.

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: In order to be qualified for licensure as an optometrist, every applicant shall demonstrate competency for certification to prescribe for and treat diseases or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa with therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (TPAs).

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Satisfactory completion of such didactic and clinical training programs for the treatment of diseases and abnormal conditions of the eye and its adnexa as are determined to be reasonable and necessary by the Board

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: delegating to personnel in his personal employ and supervised by him, such activities or functions as are nondiscretionary and do not require the exercise of professional judgment for their performance and which are usually or customarily delegated to such persons by optometrists
